e.title: Quote Engine Reference Architecture
e.summary: 商业保险实时报价平台参考架构（.NET Core+SQL Server+Azure Functions）：高吞吐 API+异步处理+财务事务完整性
e.body: Quote Engine Reference Architecture 是生产就绪的商业保险报价平台参考架构（CI/CD 完备）：演示高吞吐 API 设计、异步处理模式与金融事务完整性——.NET Core + SQL Server + Azure Functions。对 RIAA：保险报价（quoting）平台的工程化参考（费率引擎到实时报价的落地路径）。与 [[fastcashflow]]（IFRS 17 引擎）、[[insurancerating]]（费率工具）、[[actuarial-pricing]] 互补——前端报价平台与后端精算引擎的分工。关联 [[underwriting-copilot]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]。

e.summary_en: Production-ready reference architecture for commercial-insurance real-time quoting platforms (.NET Core + SQL Server + Azure Functions): high-throughput API + async processing + financial transaction integrity
e.summary_hk: 商業保險實時報價平台參考架構（.NET Core+SQL Server+Azure Functions）：高吞吐 API+異步處理+財務事務完整性
e.body_en: Quote Engine Reference Architecture is a production-ready reference architecture for commercial-insurance quoting platforms (CI/CD complete): demonstrating high-throughput API design, async processing patterns and financial transaction integrity — .NET Core + SQL Server + Azure Functions. For RIAA: the engineering reference for insurance quoting platforms (the path from rating engine to real-time quote). Complements [[fastcashflow]] (IFRS 17 engine), [[insurancerating]] (rating tools) and [[actuarial-pricing]] — the division of labour between front-end quoting platforms and back-end actuarial engines. Related: [[underwriting-copilot]], [[agentic-bop-underwriting]].
e.body_hk: Quote Engine Reference Architecture 是生產就緒的商業保險報價平台參考架構（CI/CD 完備）：演示高吞吐 API 設計、異步處理模式與金融事務完整性——.NET Core + SQL Server + Azure Functions。對 RIAA：保險報價（quoting）平台的工程化參考（費率引擎到實時報價的落地路徑）。與 [[fastcashflow]]（IFRS 17 引擎）、[[insurancerating]]（費率工具）、[[actuarial-pricing]] 互補——前端報價平台與後端精算引擎的分工。關聯 [[underwriting-copilot]]、[[agentic-bop-underwriting]]。
